decisions.why: examples (ProTurn Sheets - Disposable, Wipe Clean Consumables, Slide Sheets - Washable/Disposable) are explicitly slide sheets for patient transfer
three named products are the Ergotrics range (Morphecover, DuoRoll, Morpheroll), which are patient turning/slide-sheet systems, matching slide sheets and transfer boards
three named products (Comfort Support Pillow, Comfort Leg Support, 30 Degree Pressure Wedge) are positioning aids, matching mattresses, overlays and positioning
